method: The supplied matrix exactly matches a recovered published 454-addition SLP. A previous pooled helper-exchange search produced a verified 402-gate circuit. A follow-up remove-and-rebuild prototype used a fixed joint pool of 1828 exact forms, removed 2 to 11 helpers at a time, and repaired using closure-gain-guided choices followed by pruning; it could accept up to two extra helpers to escape local minima. Two 100-second runs found 401, first at 9.51297 seconds with seed 32 and separately at 53.1463 seconds with seed 33. This certificate contains the seed-32 401-gate candidate. It was oriented with fixed input/output signs and independently verified against all 19840 coefficients of the bundled V matrix, without unary negations or scalar multiplications.
scope: Only the supplied V matrix with original input and output coordinates and signs.
limitations: Only V was supplied; this is not a full matrix multiplication addition count.
No runtime improvement inferred from an arithmetic count.
